description_en: Modifies the name of a global IP whitelist template associated with an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 修改全局IP白名单模板名称
kebab_example: aliyun dds modify-global-security-ip-group-name --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-ig-name prod_baoxian_k8s --global-security-group-id g-xmtncwkrzqqoe59dzljb --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyGlobalSecurityIPGroupName

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html接口查询
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IP whitelist template. The name must meet the following requirements:

It can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).

It must start with a letter and end with a letter or digit.

It must be 2 to 120 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
IP白名单模板名称。IP白名单模板名称需满足如下要求：

由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）组成。

由字母开头、字母或数字结尾。

长度为2~120个字符
parameters.name: global_ig_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IP whitelist template
parameters.name: global_security_group_id

GIpList.description_en:
The IP addresses in the whitelist template.

Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). You can create up to 1,000 IP addresses or CIDR blocks for all IP address whitelists
GIpList.description_zh:
白名单模板内的IP地址。

多个IP地址需要用英文逗号隔开，所有IP白名单累积支持添加1000个IP地址或地址段

GlobalIgName.description_en: The name of the IP whitelist template

GlobalSecurityGroupId.description_en: The ID of the IP whitelist template

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html） operation to query the most recent region list
